subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Habari RECIPIENT_NAME,
Nafuatilia barua pepe yangu kuhusu kurejesha wanunuzi wasio hai na walioacha kikapu kwa {Brand}. Jambo moja linalostahili kurudiwa: tunalenga ununuzi uliothibitishwa unaosomwa upande wa seva kupitia Conversions API na postback za S2S, ukiondolewa marudio kwa kitambulisho cha agizo, ili kanuni iweke zabuni kwa mauzo halisi badala ya mibofyo ya kurudia. Kwa kiwango hicho tunarejesha ununuzi 3,000 kwa siku kutoka kwa makundi haya. Nikitumie mtazamo wa urejeshaji wa kundi lako lisilo hai?
illustrative_flags: ununuzi 3,000 kwa siku kutoka kwa wanunuzi wasio hai na walioacha kikapu (MobUpps daily recovered-purchase volume; illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 sw (Kenya) ecommerce retargeting: references prior email in first sentence; restates one proof (server-side validated-purchase optimization via Conversions API + S2S postback, dedupe by order id); one illustrative MobUpps figure (3,000 ununuzi/siku); soft CTA, one question mark; native register, no sign-off, no em-dash, no X-not-Y (positive stated with 'badala ya').
